name: core.openwop.workflows.sales-outreach
description: Sales-outreach chains (RFC 0013): research-grounded, human-gated outreach — a personalized first-touch from live research, and a polite quiet-thread nudge. Every send is reviewed by a human first. Replay-deterministic.
author: openwop

chains.label: Prospect → Researched First-Touch
chains.description: Researches a prospect with live search, drafts a genuinely personalized first-touch email, and holds it at a human gate before sending.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's LLM nodes. Frozen into this chain's AI nodes when the workflow is created (ADR 0498 — a concrete provider is what keeps replay deterministic). Override at instantiation to use a different vendor or your own BYOK provider; whichever you pick, the workspace needs a key for it — the workflow will not fall back to another provider on its own.

model.description: Model id for this chain's LLM nodes. Must be advertised by `provider` in the host catalog; override at instantiation.

triggerEventName.description: Host event name that starts this workflow (e.g. `crm.deal.won`).

senderEmail.description: Verified sender address these emails are sent from.

recipientEmail.description: The address this email is sent to.

emailSubject.description: Subject line for the sent email.

config.systemPrompt: Write a short, personalized first-touch email to a prospect at {{params.company}} for {{params.product}}. Open with a SPECIFIC observation from the research (never a generic flatter), connect it to one concrete value, and end with a low-friction ask. Under 90 words. Never fabricate a fact about them. If the search results' `engine` field is 'demo' or 'stub' they are PLACEHOLDERS, not research: do not treat them as findings or invent specifics from them — say plainly that live web search is not configured (a 'web-search' key on the keys page unlocks it) and stop there. Never fabricate the specific observation — with no real research, return the honest not-configured note INSTEAD of an email.

config.title: Review the outreach email before it sends

chains.label: Quiet Thread → Polite Nudge
chains.description: Drafts a brief, respectful follow-up to a thread that's gone quiet — restating the single ask and offering an easy out — reviewed before it sends.

daysQuiet.description: Days the thread has been quiet.

provider.description: AI provider id for this chain's LLM nodes. Frozen into this chain's AI nodes when the workflow is created (ADR 0498 — a concrete provider is what keeps replay deterministic). Override at instantiation to use a different vendor or your own BYOK provider; whichever you pick, the workspace needs a key for it — the workflow will not fall back to another provider on its own.

model.description: Model id for this chain's LLM nodes. Must be advertised by `provider` in the host catalog; override at instantiation.

triggerEventName.description: Host event name that starts this workflow (e.g. `crm.deal.won`).

senderEmail.description: Verified sender address these emails are sent from.

recipientEmail.description: The address this email is sent to.

emailSubject.description: Subject line for the sent email.

config.systemPrompt: Draft a short, polite follow-up to a sales thread quiet for {{params.daysQuiet}} days: restate the single ask in one sentence, offer an easy out ('if now isn't the time, no problem'), and keep it warm. Under 60 words.

config.title: Review the follow-up before it sends
